title: Annual Summit 2026 — Financing the hydrogen economy
about: Chatham House rule. Discussion on why hydrogen projects in North and East Africa struggle to reach financial close. Participants agreed that long-term offtake contracts and currency-risk cover are the main gaps. A Moroccan producer described a 400 MW electrolysis project seeking European buyers. A French research lead presented cost curves for solid-oxide electrolysis. Follow-up: Secretariat to connect producers with Northern European industrial buyers.

title: AI governance roundtable, Singapore
about: Chatham House rule. Participants compared AI risk-management practices in health, finance and education. Consensus that audit capacity, not principles, is the bottleneck. A health-AI CEO offered to share her model validation protocol.

title: Closed-door meeting — Gulf hydrogen offtake
about: STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL. Gulf Sovereign Capital and Sahara Solar Holdings discussed a joint venture for a hydrogen and ammonia export platform. Terms under negotiation; neither party has disclosed the talks publicly. No reference to this meeting may be shared outside the Managing Director's office.

title: Field visit — Water-food nexus in the Mekong delta
about: Visit to salinity-affected rice farms. Participants discussed financing for basin-level water management and transfer of Andean water-harvesting techniques.

title: Mesa redonda — Crédito digital para pequeños productores
about: Regla de Chatham House. Se discutió cómo combinar datos agronómicos y de pagos móviles para otorgar crédito a pequeños productores en América Latina y África Oriental. FoodBridge Africa y Andes AgriTech acordaron comparar modelos de riesgo.

title: Ocean finance breakfast
about: Public session. Speakers presented the blue-bond pipeline of the Blue Economy Accelerator and the role of guarantees in lowering coupon rates for island states.

title: Critical minerals working dinner
about: Staff summary for Secretariat use. Participants discussed traceability standards and the shortage of processing capacity in Africa. Two participants expressed interest in a co-investment platform (see Managing Director's office).

title: Cyber resilience workshop
about: Crisis simulation for a ransomware attack on a payments provider. Banks and grid operators agreed to test a joint escalation protocol.

title: Account note — Dr. Marcus Feld
about: Dr. Feld opted out of member matchmaking after being over-solicited in 2025. He remains an active advisor. Route any request through the Lumière Institute and the Head of Network Intelligence; never introduce him directly.
